caption: The drawing depicts a large, brown stoneware jar with two rounded handles on either side near the top rim. The body of the jar is slightly tapered towards the base, and the rim is wide and round. On the front of the jar, above the midsection, there is an inscription that reads "HOWE & CLARK ATHENS," positioned within an abstract, wavy blue decorative motif. This blue motif is echoed at the attachment points of the handles. The main body of the jar is shaded in various tones of brown, giving it a textured appearance, with blue accents at the handles and the upper motif. The drawing also includes two small insets on the upper right and lower right corners: the upper inset shows a close-up of the handle segment with blue decoration, and the lower inset depicts another abstract blue design resembling a floral or organic pattern, both on a similarly brown background as the jar. The artist's signature "N. Amantea" appears in the lower left margin of the image. The objects are arranged on a plain, lightly colored background, and the outlines of the drawing are marked with simple, fine lines.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
